name: ELFER R

specs.notes: Porsche Motorsport's GT3 customer car: the rear-mounted 4,194 cc flat-six, 416 kW (565 PS) as Porsche rates it, subject to BoP (about 620 bhp at 9,400 rpm unrestricted, per Fast Car); about 1,250 kg; a six-speed sequential with paddles and a mechanical limited-slip differential; 2,507 mm wheelbase, 4,619 mm long (without aero), 2,039 / 2,050 mm wide at the axles (Porsche via stuttcars.com). Torque isn't published (from the power, a high-revving NA curve); the power peak's rpm (9,000), the limiter (9,500), ~290 km/h, the ratios, weight distribution and aero (the track chassis' downforce) are estimates.

garage.blurb: A GT3 race car with its flat-six hung out behind the rear axle: it screams to 9,500, stops like nothing on the road and wants a careful right foot out of slow corners.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit: its racing wheel cut out by part, the seat found by the probe; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

source.license: CGTrader purchase (no licence file in the package; CGTrader's Royalty Free licence assumed)

limitations: Torque, the power peak's rpm, the limiter, top speed, the ratios, weight distribution and aero are estimates; the power is Porsche's BoP-dependent rating.
Provenance: parts named like a racing-sim mod (STEER_HR, a '963_CLEARLED' material, '296_ROTOR' discs); fine among friends, replace before any public release.
The game's livery replaces its race livery (its body is the game's paint); its sponsor decals stay.
